records.context: A rebuild runs the same heavy steps as a first open -- build, theme, join the stack, translate, show -- and used to execute them in one piece: Mask's "Load test data" applies a settings pack that changes the form's shape, and the whole rebuild was one freeze of about 0.4 s with the backdrop stopped. The steps are now separated by the breaths a module open takes (:meth:`_breathe_while_opening`), so the longest freeze is the longest single step. User input is held back during a breath and navigation waits, exactly as for an open.

records.source: A rebuild runs the same heavy steps as a first open -- build, theme, join the stack, translate, show -- and used to run them in one piece: Mask's "Load test data" applies a settings pack that changes the form's shape, and the whole rebuild was one freeze of about 0.4 s with the backdrop stopped. The steps are now separated by the breaths a module open takes (:meth:`_breathe_while_opening`), so the longest freeze is the longest single step. User input is held back during a breath and navigation waits, exactly as for an open.
records.translation: Uma reconstrução executa as mesmas etapas pesadas de uma primeira abertura -- construir, aplicar o tema, entrar na pilha, traduzir, exibir -- e antes as executava de uma só vez: o "Load test data" do Mask aplica um pacote de configurações que muda a forma do formulário, e a reconstrução inteira era um único congelamento de cerca de 0.4 s, com o fundo animado parado. Agora as etapas são separadas pelas pausas que a abertura de um módulo faz (:meth:`_breathe_while_opening`), de modo que o congelamento mais longo é o da etapa individual mais longa. A entrada do usuário fica retida durante uma pausa e a navegação espera, exatamente como em uma abertura.
